waves.purpose: shared shell recovery and creator integration

items.name: Contextual account/role projection and Personal-context authority extensions
items.acceptance: universal account plus contextual role/control without global Player/GM caste or authority bleed
items.rollback: disable successor projections; preserve existing identity/Campaign data

items.name: Creative identity lifecycle provenance foundation
items.acceptance: stable creative identity/lifecycle/provenance remains pre-authoritative
items.rollback: disable creator feature while retaining readable/exportable records

items.name: Automated-run authority and lifecycle foundation
items.acceptance: automation cannot exceed grant/owning-domain authority and shares ordinary Event history
items.rollback: disable automated-run feature; ordinary play unaffected

items.name: Personal Home and workspace switching
items.acceptance: useful no-Campaign Home and safe Personal↔Campaign context switching
items.rollback: owning screens remain available without dashboard projection

items.name: Asynchronous Action submission durable GM inbox and delayed resolution
items.migration: conditional additive status/inbox/recovery metadata over A6
items.acceptance: one proposal yields one attributable outcome across disconnect and delayed GM review

items.name: Bounded Campaign Activity and downtime integration
items.migration: expected bounded activity/project bookkeeping where absent
items.acceptance: between-session work respects owning-domain resource/consent/hidden-information rules
items.rollback: disable Campaign Activity orchestration without deleting owner-domain state

items.name: Creative Library Story Bible Project Memory
items.acceptance: authorization precedes search/count/topology and governed facts remain references

items.name: Cozy Solo core loop
items.migration: mostly automation/activity linkage; domain payloads stay with owners
items.acceptance: bounded resumable Cozy loop with meaningful human-choice stops and no-AI path

items.name: AutoGM Single-Encounter runner
items.acceptance: bounded deterministic encounter recovers without reroll/reseed/duplicate effects

items.name: Creator Workshop reusable library and Sandbox/Lab integration
items.migration: conditional Workshop organization/provenance metadata; no duplicate governed payloads
items.acceptance: personal creation/sandbox cannot silently mutate Campaign or global canonical truth

items.name: Idea Inbox Inspiration Engine
items.migration: saved ideas only; generated candidates ephemeral until save
items.acceptance: capture-first and no silent seed mutation; deterministic/no-AI tools complete

items.name: Guided Creation Workflows
items.acceptance: guidance optional with skip/revisit/freeform escape and pre-authoritative completion

items.name: Narrative Design Lab Continuity Open Threads
items.acceptance: nonlinear planning plus evidence-backed advisory continuity without rewriting truth
items.rollback: planning data remains; analysis can be disabled

items.name: Writing Studio Revision Workspace
items.acceptance: recoverable exact revisions, explicit transforms and exact-revision export

items.name: Reuse Remix Transformation
items.acceptance: independent derivatives with provenance, source-drift review and no protected-context copy

items.name: Notification visibility recovery and hybrid cross-device integration
items.migration: conditional durable attention/recovery metadata; source outcomes remain owner-domain
items.acceptance: authorization-before-aggregation, status lookup, cross-device reauth and one hybrid history
items.rollback: source state remains accessible; enhanced projections/notifications can be disabled

items.name: Creator Command Center and end-to-end creator acceptance
items.migration: minimal resume metadata only if required; no duplicate truth
items.acceptance: returning creator resumes authorized work with noncoercive attention and visible assistance scope

items.name: Connected Cozy shared play
items.acceptance: invitation-only shared Cozy preserves independent authority/consent and exact contribution accounting

items.name: AutoGM Mini-Campaign director
items.migration: conditional parent/child run linkage and exact-once completion receipts
items.acceptance: finite Adventure graph with human route decisions, hidden-state safety and exact-once child progression

items.name: Automated-play recovery safety and end-to-end acceptance
items.migration: no new state engine; only evidence/compatibility deltas if proven necessary
items.acceptance: cross-mode deterministic recovery, optional-AI failure safety and no authority expansion

items.name: Whole-program hybrid acceptance
items.acceptance: live→async→GM result→Player return→live plus Personal/creator/automated continuity across supported platforms

non_reopening_rule: Successor implementation is additive. Predecessor Stage A completion is reopened only by fresh independent evidence of a predecessor regression.
activation_rule: This matrix is planning authority only until APW-08 completes_verified and the canonical selector explicitly selects an implementation attempt.
